capabilities: Assign gradient colors to folders from the context menu
Cascade colors to subfolders and files by depth
Badge non-markdown files with extension pills
Export and import color configuration as JSON
disambiguation: Not a theming tool for the whole app; it only colors folders and files in the file explorer.
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice: 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.'
problem: Obsidian's file explorer offers no built-in way to visually color-code folders and files without writing CSS yourself.
summary: File-explorer styling plugin that assigns gradient colors to folders and files via right-click, cascading colors to subfolders.
